WHAT YOU MAY REFER

Software and knowledge-driven solutions.

Included, after programme approval

  • Eligible POSH Navigator digital checklists and online compliance assessments
  • Approved software access plans and guided inquiry tools sold by the platform
  • Specified digital learning or self-service products listed as commissionable
  • Permitted paid upgrades or renewals within the first 12 months of a referred customer relationship

The current staging checkout remains test-only; test payments never produce real commissions.

Excluded from automatic commissions

  • Individual legal consultation, representation, case-specific advice or advocate fees
  • IC/LC appointments, inquiry assignments, government tenders, regulated procurement and statutory roles
  • Training workshops, audits, professional services and bespoke institutional contracts unless separately agreed in writing and lawful
  • Self-purchases, related-party sales, false leads, refunds, chargebacks or sales made before partner approval

Never imply government endorsement, guaranteed compliance, certification or legal outcomes.

A CONTROLLED PARTNER JOURNEY

How it works.

Apply

Tell us your professional background and how you reach relevant audiences. No fee or PAN/bank details are requested at this stage.

Get verified

We screen for conflicts, agree on permitted products, validate tax and banking details securely, and issue an agreement and unique code.

Refer responsibly

Share the approved code or link with people who choose to use it. Attribution is subject to proof, a 90-day window and one partner per customer.

Receive cleared earnings

Only valid settled orders enter the ledger. A 45-day hold, refund review and independent finance approvals precede bank payouts.

PAYMENT SAFETY

Reliable records before any payout.

Partner payment standards

  • Monthly payout run on the 20th for commission cleared at least 45 days after successful delivery/payment verification
  • Minimum release balance of ₹2,000; smaller balances carry forward
  • Indian verified bank account and tax/KYC review required; no cash or third-party payouts
  • Applicable tax deduction, GST documentation and finance-approved reconciliation
  • Annual retroactive tier adjustment after the fiscal-year review, within 90 days after 31 March where verification is complete

Fraud and conflict safeguards

  • Referral attribution locked only after accepted customer consent or code use and verified purchase
  • No payment on fake, duplicate, uncollected, refunded or disputed orders
  • No self-referral, undisclosed related-party purchase, misleading promotion or spam
  • Two separate finance approvers; negative corrections or chargebacks offset future unpaid commission
  • Audit trail of order, referral, tax, approval and payout reference—no POSH complaint or case details shared with partners

The public referral and payout automation will not be activated until gateway verification, partner identity checks, financial reconciliation, and final legal/tax approval are completed. Read the proposed programme terms and controls.

PARTNER QUESTIONS

Useful answers before applying.

Does joining cost anything?

No. Applying and joining after approval do not carry a programme membership charge. We never ask for a deposit to release earnings.

Does the rate apply to the whole year?

Yes, for eligible revenue in the Indian financial year. Reaching ₹5 lakh gives 25%, and ₹10 lakh gives 30% on the entire qualifying annual total. A reconciliation credit is subject to chargebacks, refunds, tax review and the applicable agreement.

Are commissions paid on every product?

No. Only specifically approved Navigator software, checklists and digital products qualify. Legal advice, representation, statutory appointments, government procurement and unapproved professional services are excluded.

Do I need a GST number or PAN now?

No sensitive identity or banking documents are requested in this public form. Before approval or payout, applicable KYC, tax registration, invoicing and bank verification will be completed through a secure process.

Can I earn on a training or institutional deal?

Such engagements are excluded from automatic programme commission. Any lawful, separately authorised commercial arrangement needs a specific written agreement before the sale.

Can I immediately generate a referral link?

No. Only approved, contracted partners can receive an active code. Checkout, attribution and payouts remain unavailable on this staging site until tested and authorised.
